title: BIONEXT on Oppla
text: BIONEXT is the Biodiversity Nexus project. It explores connections between biodiversity and climate, food, water, energy, transport and health. It focuses on transformative change for sustainability and nature-centred futures. This source is part of the approved Oppla BIONEXT source boundary.

title: About BIONEXT
text: BIONEXT is a European research project focused on the biodiversity nexus. It examines how biodiversity loss, biodiversity recovery and human systems interact. It develops knowledge, resources and decision-support approaches for transformative change. This source is part of the approved Oppla BIONEXT source boundary.

title: BIONEXT Resources
text: The BIONEXT resources section is the approved source area for project outputs, publications, policy briefs, reports, deliverables and other materials associated with the BIONEXT project. In Ask BIONEXT 2.0, questions about outputs, publications, reports, policy briefs, deliverables and resources should prioritise this source area.

title: Decision analysis in environmental decision-making
text: The BIONEXT decision-analysis area is the approved source area for environmental decision-making, multi-criteria decision analysis, criteria, options, trade-offs, preferences, complexity, uncertainty and transparent decision support. In Ask BIONEXT 2.0, questions about decision analysis or MCDA should prioritise this source area.

title: BIONEXT News Articles
text: The BIONEXT news section is the approved source area for project news, updates, blogs, workshops, webinars and communication outputs associated with BIONEXT.

title: CORDIS BIONEXT project page
text: The CORDIS BIONEXT project page is an approved external source for official European Union project information about BIONEXT, including the project identity, funding context, grant information and official project description.

title: IPBES Transformative Change Assessment citation page
text: This approved IPBES page provides reference context for IPBES material related to transformative change assessment and knowledge management. In Ask BIONEXT 2.0, it may be used only for questions where IPBES or transformative change assessment is directly relevant.
